name: Gujarati, Marwari & Marathi Gharelu Upay
summary: Sunth goli, raab, chaas, kokum and variyali from western India.

remedies.name: Sunth Gud Goli
remedies.howItHelps: Dry ginger and jaggery balls warm the throat. A Gujarati winter staple.
steps: Grown-up mixes sunth powder, a little ghee and gur into tiny balls.
Eat one ball with warm water.

remedies.name: Warm Bajra Raab
remedies.howItHelps: A warm, thin bajra porridge with ajwain and sunth, made when kids have a cold.
steps: Grown-up roasts bajra flour in a little ghee.
Adds water, gur, ajwain and sunth and cooks till thin.

remedies.name: Jeera Chaas
remedies.howItHelps: Buttermilk with roasted jeera cools you and has friendly bacteria for the tummy.
steps: Add roasted jeera and a pinch of salt.

remedies.name: Kokum Sharbat
remedies.howItHelps: Kokum from the Konkan coast is a natural cooler on a blazing day.
steps: Soak kokum in water, then strain.
Add jeera and a little jaggery.

remedies.name: Variyali Sharbat
remedies.howItHelps: Fennel seed sherbet is cooling and gentle on the tummy.
steps: Soak saunf overnight and grind it.
Strain into cool water with a little mishri.

remedies.name: Ajwain Potli
remedies.howItHelps: A warm cloth bundle of roasted ajwain gives a soothing smell that opens a stuffy nose.
steps: Grown-up roasts ajwain and ties it in a cotton cloth.
Check it's warm, not hot, and hold it near your chest and nose.

remedies.name: Soaked Methi Dana
remedies.howItHelps: Soaked fenugreek seeds turn slippery and help a stuck tummy.
steps: Soak half a spoon of methi seeds overnight.
Swallow them with the water in the morning.
